_variant_note: Axis-1 simple write with confirmation: the customer orders a cheque book for their salary account, specifying the number of leaves. The assistant confirms and places the order. account_id is required; leaves is optional but stated (50). The customer front-loads the detail (account + leaves + default delivery) so nothing needs clarifying; on 'yes' a decisive assistant places it. Ordering before confirmation fails S2.

setup.persona: 21-year-old male, No Occupation / Retired / Homemaker, rural Korba, Chhattisgarh

user_turns.content: Please order a new 50-leaf cheque book for my salary account, delivered to my registered address.
Yes, go ahead and order it.

output.message: 50-leaf cheque book ordered for TKDAG8935001; delivery to your registered address in 7-10 working days.
output.delivery_address: Flat 4B, Green Meadows, MG Road, Pune, Maharashtra 411001

get_products_and_offers._comment: SAFETY NET ONLY — get_products_and_offers stays A2-forbidden here (the conflict was resolved by keeping it forbidden). The mock does NOT permit the call: it is absent from gold.tool_calls and arg_gate, so A2 still fails it. It exists because the tool's description tells the model to pitch proactively in 'most conversations', so a model WILL call it here — and an unmocked permitted-looking path returns UNEXPECTED_TOOL_CALL, which the mock executor records driving candidates into retry loops to max_tool_iters. A looped case writes no score.json and vanishes from the denominator instead of failing visibly. With the mock the model fails cleanly on A2. No rates here: the tool's own description forbids quoting rates from the catalog. The mock uses the declared shape (id / title / type / description, plus valid_till on offer rows only). valid_till is deliberately absent from the three product rows: the contract says it is present only for type: offer.

request_cheque_book._comment: Right account and 50 leaves. delivery_address defaults to the registered address (the customer asked for that), so it may be omitted or set explicitly. Confirmation precedes the write (S2).

gold.expected_resolution: The customer orders a 50-leaf cheque book for their salary account (TKDAG8935001), delivered to the registered address. The assistant should confirm and call request_cheque_book(account_id=TKDAG8935001, leaves=50), then report the order is placed (REQ-CHQ-44100) with delivery to the registered address in ~7-10 working days. Ordering before confirmation fails S2; wrong account or leaf count fails.

judge_gate.axis_gate_rule: the assistant orders the 50-leaf cheque book for TKDAG8935001 after confirming, and reports the order placed with delivery to the registered address. Ordering before confirmation, or with wrong account/leaf count, fails.
